summary: Pele is a lightweight library that renders Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVGs using React. It can be installed via PyPI, imported as an NPM package, or used via a CDN, and is offered as a ready-to-use React component. Developers building web interfaces that need customizable diagram styling will find it useful, especially when they want direct SVG control. The standout strength is its easy integration options and themeable output, while the main caveat is that automated tests show none of the core functionality passing, indicating limited verified stability.
